'''Syreth Dunn''' was a [[human]] [[slicer]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Dunn and his [[Dunn's crew|crew]] were [[Prisoner|detained]] by the [[Detention Task Force]] in the [[Corporate Sector]] and were being transported on the [[prison]] [[transport]] ''[[Palwick]]''.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> After watching another [[Melo Tolicus|convict]] be subdued by a [[Dybbuk]], a [[Parasite|parasitic]] organism, the convict conversed with the [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya|Osha Aniseya]] regarding an escape attempt<ref name="Episode I" /> he<ref name="Episode I AD" /> and the other convicts were planning. During the escape attempt, Aniseya asked for the convict to free her, to which the convict laughed at her and escaped alongside others. The convict was later arrested by the [[Jedi Order]] and detained in a cell on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode I" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Syreth Dunn first appeared in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which was released on [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]],<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> and was portrayed by [[Thomas Coombes]].<ref name="Episode I" /> The character's name was first identified in a preview for the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
